results.note: The sea-view deck of Bambu Huts (Bambu Jungle Lounge), where the Sunday Session is held, above Haad Yuan: guests at low wooden tables under red umbrellas, with granite rocks and the bay behind. This is candidate 1, the venue's header photo on phangan.events (it is a wide crop of a 1440x1080 Facebook original). Rejected: candidate 2 (portrait, only 729 px wide, shows the beach rather than the venue) and candidate 3 (a season poster covered in text). Also searched: the entrix.vip event page (posters and a logo only), all 28 phangan.events Bambu event images (all text posters), and Commons and Openverse (nothing for Bambu Huts).

A Saturday-night crowd dancing with arms raised under string lights inside Hollystone. Hollystone Phangan posted it on its own Facebook page. I cropped the 1586x1055 original to 16:9 (rows 40-932) to cut off a 'HOLLYSTONE' logo badge at the bottom. It is a little soft at the edges but fine at card size. Both candidates were rejected: one is a logo, the other a text flyer. No venue photos were found on the official site (only square record-label covers), RA (no venue photo, 21 flyers), phangan.events (24 event images, all flyers), Megatix, Beatportal, SoundCloud or YouTube (all flyers, logos or title cards). Backup if wanted: a sharper photo of the DJ booth under its thatched roof, https://www.welove-kohphangan.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/327310897_830640868036202_6058009428823177000_n.jpg (1440x959). It comes from a third-party listing and probably originated on Hollystone's Facebook, but I could not confirm that.

An aerial night shot of the Utopia jungle rave: the arched-truss stage, green lasers and smoke over a packed crowd, with the rock wall and jungle behind. It is the still frame of the hero video on the official homepage, already 16:9. The stage matches the daytime venue photo. Candidate 1 (a daytime venue shot from phangan.events, 1280x589) also passes but is softer and less striking. Candidate 2 is a flyer covered in text.

Nai Thon Beach by day: wide golden sand, a row of umbrellas and loungers, turquoise sea and the forested north headland under a blue sky. The photo is geotagged on the beach. This is candidate 1 (the 1280x1707 portrait thumbnail), cropped to 16:9 (rows 800-1520) so the beach fills the card instead of empty sky. The crop is a modification under CC BY-SA. It is a different photo from the area card (the Flickr tnocapital shot taken from the casuarina shade with kayaks). Candidate 2 (pink dusk with rocks) is a good backup. Rejected: File:Naithon-beach-wooden-bridge.jpg, which carries repeated freepik stock watermarks. I also looked at Flickr CC photos through Openverse: one has a photographer's signature watermark and the rest are weaker. A Commons geosearch found no other beach photos.

results.credit: © Natural Restaurant (ครัวธรรมชาติ)
results.note: Inside the airport branch: a rock waterfall wall with the green 'NATURAL Restaurant' sign, boat-shaped wooden booths around a pond, and plants everywhere. This is candidate 1, the site's og:image. naturalphuket.com is the airport branch's own site ('Natural Restaurant Airport', Sakhu, 5 minutes from the airport, 'tropical waterfall setting'). I compared all 30 photos on the site; the largest size is 1024 px and this is the clearest view of the place. Candidate 2 is a portrait close-up of food.

The shop front, with the 'Sabai Phuket MASSAGE - Phuket Airport' sign and the number 18/18, which matches the branch address (18/18 Moo 1, Sakhu). This is the og:image of the official site, which describes itself as 'Sabai Massage & Spa Phuket Airport Branch'. The site embeds all its images inside the page as base64 data, so the url field is the page; there is no separate file URL. There were no candidates. Backup: the reception photo on the same page (gold reception desk and rose-petal foot baths, 1499x1000, alt text 'Sabai Massage and Spa Phuket Airport reception').
